moments.title: Equity as a dating profile: founder and CEO who has public breakdowns
moments.summary: The facilitator runs equity as a personality profile for a teens class — occupation founder and CEO, big dreams, occasional public breakdowns — and draws the answer out of the room: the public breakdowns are the share price fluctuating and sometimes crashing.
moments.evidence: Exactly, right? The share price generally tends to fluctuate and sometimes it tends to crash, yeah?

moments.title: Green flags: equity is the wealth creator in your portfolio
moments.summary: The green flags in the profile are ambition and growth: equity is described as the thing that actually creates wealth in a portfolio, a long-term winner that generates great amounts of money if held for a long period.
moments.evidence: Green flags, they're ambitious, their equity is the one that's actually going to create wealth in your portfolio. So it's a wealth creator, it's a long-term winner.

moments.title: Red flags: mood swings and an emotional rollercoaster
moments.summary: The red flag is that equity has mood swings — the share price fluctuates over time, so it is an emotional rollercoaster because you have no idea how the shares will perform.
moments.evidence: So very often it's an emotional rollercoaster because you have no idea how the shares are going to perform.
